summary.en: Wajba is a local-first bilingual Arabic/English MENA meal-planning web app. It combines a static recipe catalog with weekly and monthly planning, Ramadan mode, dietary filters, pantry quantity matching, grocery aggregation, cooking timers, browser persistence, family URL sharing,
